name: nxdsol-website
description: NXDSOL - AI & Machine Learning Consulting Website

scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js
scripts.validate:html: node -e "const lint = require('html5-lint'); const fs = require('fs'); const html = fs.readFileSync('index.html', 'utf8'); lint(html, {}, (err, results) => { if (err) { console.error(err); process.exit(1); } results.messages.forEach(m => { console.log(m.type + ': ' + m.message + ' (line ' + m.line + ')'); }); console.log('Total: ' + results.messages.length + ' messages'); if (results.messages.some(m => m.type === 'error')) process.exit(1); });"
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run validate:html && npm run check:links
